summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Vision

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists LaMa in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions”. The page names Roman Suvorov, Victor Lempitsky as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
